answers.core: It doesn't explicitly require core changes, but an add-on implementing this functionality would be much more difficult to create and could quickly become outdated.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around in script, but the solution is brittle and totally undocumented (not that I'd be on-board with documenting it anyways, it should not be done!!)
